sources.title: NVIDIA Nemotron 3.5 Bolt 74B-A9B 24GB - SourceForge.net
sources.snippet: NVIDIA Nemotron 3.5 Bolt 74B-A9B 24GB is an open-weight multimodal AI model optimized for running autonomous agents on systems with 24GB of GPU memory. Derived from Nemotron 3.5 Super VL through NVIDIA's Star Elastic compression method, it features 74B total parameters with approximately 9B activated per token.
